description:
Read permanent offered-bot histories to assess results after selection, including losses and withdrawals.

        Default returns version summaries with baseline dates, source status, latest
        observations and coverage gaps; page using next_offset. events=true returns dated
        observations/changes with integrity hashes; page using next_after_id. A null cursor
        ends either sequence; unknown exact filters return empty items. Legacy first-offer
        dates may be unknown, and simulated VFT observations are sampled, not full trade
        ledgers. Check freshness and gaps. Use evaluate_bots for current dashboard rankings.
        Free, unauthenticated read; does not change admission or customer deployments.
        Invalid arguments/upstream failure return an MCP tool error.

after_id.description: Event mode only: return recording IDs greater than this cursor; start at 0 and continue with next_after_id. Ignored when events=false.
after_id.title: After Id

bot_id.description: Exact case-sensitive bot_id from an evaluation row or history record; omit for all bots. Not a symbol, name or partial search.
bot_id.title: Bot Id

events.description: False lists offered-version summaries. True lists dated events in recording order, including global gaps/corrections when unfiltered.
events.title: Events

limit.description: Maximum version summaries or events per page, 1–100; defaults to 20 in either mode.
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: Version mode only: zero-based offset, continued with next_offset. Ignored when events=true.
offset.title: Offset

strategy_version.description: Exact immutable version from an evaluation rental record or history item. Omit for all versions; combines with bot_id using AND.
strategy_version.title: Strategy Version

name: bot_history

bot_id.description: Null for a global coverage-gap or collector-correction event.
bot_id.title: Bot Id

data.description: Kind-specific immutable observation, offer change, gap or correction details.
data.title: Data

id.description: Monotonically increasing recording ID used for event pagination.
id.title: Id

observed_at.description: Time the event/evidence was observed, Unix seconds UTC.
observed_at.title: Observed At

recorded_at.description: Time the evidence was ingested, Unix seconds UTC; may be later for recovered history.
recorded_at.title: Recorded At

sha256.description: Event hash in its bot/version chain, or the separate global chain; see hash_format.
sha256.title: Sha256

baseline.description: Disclosed starting observation for this offer history; may postdate original listing.
baseline.title: Baseline

catalog_state.description: Last observed offered/withdrawn state, separate from VFT status or customer deployment closure.
catalog_state.title: Catalog State

first_known_offered_at.description: Earliest retained positive offer evidence, Unix seconds UTC.
first_known_offered_at.title: First Known Offered At

first_offered_at.description: Exact first-offer Unix timestamp when proved; null for legacy versions with unknown original offer time.
first_offered_at.title: First Offered At

latest_observed_performance.description: Last sampled simulated VFT result; historical when performance_fresh=false, null if none.
latest_observed_performance.title: Latest Observed Performance

outputSchema.description: Version mode includes coverage/next_offset; event mode includes order/next_after_id.

count.description: Version mode: total matching versions. Event mode: number of events in this page.
count.title: Count

coverage.description: Version mode: permanent cohort coverage, baseline provenance and publication gaps.
coverage.title: Coverage

next_after_id.description: Event mode only: pass as after_id with unchanged filters; null means caught up.
next_after_id.title: Next After Id

next_offset.description: Version mode only: next offset, or null at the end.
next_offset.title: Next Offset

order.description: Event ordering: recording order, which may differ from observation dates.
order.title: Order

outputSchema.title: HistoryResult
